# UI SDK Skill

Curated by Skill Harbor: Build accessible interfaces with the ui-sdk library in React, Vue, Svelte, Solid or web components, with keyboard navigation, focus, ARIA and tests. It requires pnpm: npm fails on this repo because its workspace uses the catalog: protocol. Components ship no styles of their own, with an optional default look.

The skill offers two paths: build an interface from the shipped components, like a settings page, a form or a command palette, or build a component or behavior ui-sdk does not ship, like a stepper, splitter, transfer list or emoji picker, from the same behaviors in @ui-sdk/core. Every path ends agent-ready, through createAgent, agent tools and WebMCP, and tested for keyboard, focus, ARIA, server rendering and right to left. The docs for the installed version ship inside each package, with llms.txt as the index, so read only the pages the task needs. Honest reserves: the repo is huge, 8,042 files, and the skill assumes @ui-sdk packages are installed in the project. The sandbox install under npm failed with EUNSUPPORTEDPROTOCOL, and the pnpm install was not verified in the sandbox, so install with pnpm and check the result yourself. By @vercel-labs, listed here with credit to its creator. Discovered via GitHub. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
